definition: The typical form of an organism, strain, gene, or characteristic as it occurs in nature, as distinguished from mutant forms.
manuscriptExample: Heterozygous mutants exhibited a 50% reduction in enzyme activity relative to wild-type littermate controls.
conferenceExample: Reviewer 2 requested wild-type rescue expression vectors to confirm gene specificity.

definition: A period during an experiment where drug treatment is withdrawn and cells are washed to evaluate signal reversibility.
manuscriptExample: Inhibition of receptor autophosphorylation was fully reversible following a 2-hour compound washout.
conferenceExample: The panel requested a washout study to determine if targeted pathway shutdown induced persistent senescence.
